title: NXP PAC metadata
description: Schema to define NXP PAC chip metadata

chips.description: Chip part numbers provided by this definition

nvic_prio_bits.description: The amount of bits used for the nvic priority

interrupts.description: A map of the interrupts of the chip

pin.description: Pin provided on a chip. This does not include power pins.

supply.description: The name of the power domain a pin belongs to.

iomuxc.description: IOMUXC metadata for the pin. Not allowed if the chip isn't an RT1xxx family device

feature.description: Rust Feature required to "unlock" the pin.

block.description: The yaml block used for the peripheral. Should point to a file in 'data/metadata/peripherals' without extension. E.g.: mcxa/WWDT. If the block name is different from the YAML file name, then you can specify that as: mcxa/WWDT::OTHERBLOCK

module.description: Optional name that will be used for the Rust

address.description: The memory address of this peripheral instance. Specified as a hex string

flexcomm.description: Indicates which (LP)FLEXCOMM instance this peripheral belongs to. Optional if the chip does not have FLEXCOMM instances, or the peripheral does not belong to FLEXCOMM

description: LPC55 uses fixed DMA channels for peripherals.
RT1xxx, S32 and MCX use the DMA mux to select the request channel for a peripheral

only_in.description: A regular expression to specify which chips this peripheral is available for. This can be used to define a superset chip and share most mappings with subset chips

gate.description: Clock & reset control for the peripheral

enable.description: The name of the register that gates/enables the clock to the peripheral

reset.description: The name of the register that resets the peripheral

config.description: The name of the config type used for setting up the clocks

bit.description: The name of the bit field inside the MRCC registers. Defaults to the lowercased peripheral name if not manually specified.

pins.description: Pins where the signal is available

iomuxc_daisy.description: IOMUXC Daisy register used for this signal. Depending on the signal this may be optional. Only allowed on RT1xxx devices. Hexadecimal value

peripheral_pin.description: Pin where a peripheral signal is available

alt.description: Alt mode the pin must be placed into.

iomuxc_daisy.description: Daisy value to write to select this pin for the signal. Only allowed when the signal has a iomuxc_daisy value.

dma_mux.description: A DMA mux selection for a peripheral.

signal.description: The signal being muxed for the peripheral.

mux.description: The DMA mux to use. For LPC55, this is the DMA instance to use. For others, the DMAMUX peripheral instance

request.description: The request channel this signal is attached to.
